# DERIVED coverage ledger — Core

**DERIVED — not a decided artifact.** Generated by `project-bin/coverage-preflight.sh` on
2026-10-14 by joining the build plan's `claims` blocks with the project's BRDs,
because no `coverage-ledger.md` exists. Nobody signed this off, and it contains only
what the plan already claimed — it invents nothing and it reads no code and no model.

It has no NON-BUILDABLE table, so a leaf that is deliberately deferred or descoped will
show as UNCLAIMED here. To fix that properly, review this file and commit it as
`architecture/modules/Core/coverage-ledger.md` with the reasons filled in.
